About Me & TinkuCreationss

About Me

Hello! My name is Vishnu. I am the creator of TinkuCreationss. I am passionate about mobile video editing, creative design, and digital content creation.

I started exploring video editing because I enjoyed creating creative edits and experimenting with different editing ideas. Over time, this interest developed into TinkuCreationss, where I can share my editing projects and resources with other creators.

About My Channel

TinkuCreationss is my creative platform where I share video-editing related content, editing ideas, project previews, and resources for creators.

The website and my social-media channels work together: the videos show the editing ideas and project previews, while this website provides the related projects and resources in an organized way.

How TinkuCreationss Works

  1. I create and edit mobile video projects.
  2. I prepare a project preview so creators can see the editing style before opening it.
  3. I publish projects with codes such as TC001, TC002, TC003, and so on.
  4. Where a project requires specific fonts or resources, the relevant links are provided with the project.
  5. I regularly add new projects so creators can discover more editing ideas and resources.
  6. I share project previews and editing content through my YouTube and Instagram channels.

Our Goal

My goal is to build TinkuCreationss into a useful platform for creators who enjoy mobile video editing and want to discover new editing projects and ideas.

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how TinkuCreationss handles information when you visit this website.

Information We Collect

Analytics

If analytics services are added, they may collect information such as pages visited, device or browser information, and general usage data to help improve the website.

Third-Party Links

Project and font links may take you to third-party websites or services. TinkuCreationss is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those third-party services.

Updates

This Privacy Policy may be updated when website features or services change. The latest version will be published on this page.
